meta.title: @tpcowork/dsh-ui
meta.description: Presentation layer: adapts branding, themes, the home page, sidebar and General settings through DSH theme, slot and layout services. Keeping appearance changes together makes styling and upstream upgrades easier to maintain.

ui.developerModeDescription: Choose and manage Agent presets, and show execution traces and code diffs. New tasks use Standard mode when disabled.
ui.navigationFailed: Could not open this page. Try again.
ui.authExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
ui.notifyDescription: Send desktop notifications when a task completes, fails, or needs approval.
ui.preferenceFailed: Could not save this setting. Try again.
ui.greetingSubtitle: Expert AI for research, analysis, and working together
ui.shortcutKeySearchPlaceholder: Press a key combination to search…
ui.shortcutResetAllDescription: This clears all custom keybinding overrides and restores every command to its default binding.

ui.modelSettingsIntro: Manage model providers and configure models for your conversations.
ui.modelSettingsEmpty: No providers yet. Add one to get started.
ui.appearanceInterfaceDescription: Choose the app theme and interface typography.
ui.appearanceThemeDescription: Choose light, dark, or match the system.
ui.appearanceTextSizeDescription: Change the text size across the app while keeping icons and layout dimensions.
ui.appearanceTextFontDescription: Choose a font for conversation content. Leave blank for the default.
ui.appearanceCodeDescription: Set code typography independently of the interface font size.
ui.appearanceCodeSizeDescription: Change the text size in code blocks.
ui.appearanceCodeFontDescription: Choose a font for code. A monospace font is recommended.
ui.appearanceTerminalFontDescription: Choose a terminal font. Leave blank for the default.
ui.notifySoundDescription: When notifications are enabled, you can mute the task notification sound separately.
ui.askAutoContinueDescription: When enabled, Agent questions automatically continue after 5 minutes without an answer. When disabled, current and future questions wait for your response.
ui.showReasoningDescription: Show full reasoning inside the message stream. When off, the first reasoning item in each turn remains visible.
ui.showTodosDescription: Show todo tool cards inside the message stream.
ui.languageDescription: Choose the display language used by the application UI.
ui.interactionDescription: While TP Cowork is running, add follow-up actions to the queue or guide them to run after the next tool call.
ui.usageUnavailable: Usage stats are unavailable. Please try again.
ui.guideWelcomeBody: Before you start, set up the interface, how you'll use TP Cowork, and how much of its work to show.
ui.guideWelcomeNote: It takes a few steps, and you can change everything later in Settings.
ui.guideSkipBody: Choices you've made are kept. You can still change the language, theme, and font size in Settings, and reopen this guide from General settings.
ui.guideLanguageBody: Choose the language of the TP Cowork interface.
ui.guideThemeBody: Choose light or dark, or follow the system appearance.
ui.guideTheme_dark: Easier on the eyes at night and in low light.
ui.guideTheme_system: Switch automatically with the operating system.
ui.guideFontBody: Change the text size across the app while keeping icons and layout dimensions.
ui.guideFont_13_body: More compact, so more fits on screen.
ui.guideDoneBody: Your choices are saved. You can change them later under Settings > Appearance and General settings.
ui.guideReopenDescription: Go through the first-run guide again to set up the interface, how you'll use TP Cowork, and how much of its work to show.
ui.guidePurposeTitle: What would you like TP Cowork to help with?
ui.guidePurposeBody: We'll tailor the interface and tools to fit the way you work.
ui.guidePurpose_office_body: Edit documents, organize data, create presentations, and more
ui.guidePurpose_development_body: Change code, debug problems, run commands, manage project files, and more. Turns on Developer mode, which shows agent presets and usage readouts.
ui.guideProcessTitle: How much detail would you like to see?
ui.guideProcessBody: This only changes how progress is shown, not what TP Cowork can do.
ui.guideProcess_compact_body: See only the results and keep the interface clean
ui.guideProcess_standard_body: Results first, with only the important steps and actions
ui.guideProcess_detailed_body: See the full process for easier debugging and troubleshooting
